provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled two-conformer fast-exchange proxy S_j=scale*[f_A*r_jA^(-6)+(1-f_A)*r_jB^(-6)], with a common unknown equilibrium population f_A in[0,1]. Treat all distances and scale as exact. This explicitly stipulated proxy excludes spin diffusion, correlation-time differences and cross-relaxation sign changes; it is not a general quantitative NOE equation.
analysis_policy: Infer f_A from the first contact only. Use the second to check the same inferred population and predict the third without fitting it. Effective distance is (S_first/scale)^(-1/6). No residence times or rate constants are observed.
scope: Ensemble geometry and identifiability, without a claim about a named molecule or experimentally validated structure.
